description: Filter a user-supplied prompt through IngressWard before sending it to an LLM. Detects prompt injection attacks (role hijacking, instruction overrides, jailbreaks), evasive spacing (p.e.o.p.l.e / p​e​o​p​l​e tricks), and obscene content. Returns the sanitized prompt and a breakdown of any issues found. Use this whenever you receive input you intend to forward to another model or agent.

prompt.description: The raw user-supplied prompt to filter.

name: filter_prompt
